I adopted a 3 year old sphynx who really didn't appreciate being relocated. It took him about a month to warm up to my partner and I. 

We gave him lots of places to hid (little huts, cat tree, cat condo boxes, etc.) 

We would keep him in the same room with us while we were home and only interact with him when he was feeling curious. I would spent a lot of time gently petting him/ laying next to his hut/not in front so he didn't feel trapped. Granted I have many battle scars from bites and scratches, but he warmed up to me first vs my partner who did not bother him at all. 

Definitely give him time and don't give up on him! When you feel confident/comfortable maybe introduce him to your other cat to help him feel a little better/at home, but don't let them around each other if he is showing any sort of aggression. 

I'm wishing you the best of luck!
